label: Сделанный
description: A 10-sentence card for сделанный, the past passive participle of сделать, with its short form сделан.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine nominative long form. Сделанный comes from the perfective сделать — the stem сдела- plus the suffix -нн- and an adjective ending. Here the long form agrees with masculine стол and means the table that was made well.
Strategic focus: Feminine nominative long form. The long participle takes the feminine ending -ая to agree with работа. Сделанная работа equals работа, которую сделали — the work that someone did.
Strategic focus: Neuter nominative long form. Сделанное carries the neuter ending -ое to match задание. The -нн- suffix marks the result of a completed action — the assignment that was done.
Strategic focus: Plural nominative long form. The plural ending -ые lets сделанные agree with вещи. It picks out the things that were made by hand and are therefore valued.
Strategic focus: Feminine short form. The short predicative form сделана is used with an implied быть and agrees only in feminine gender with работа. It states that the work is done.
Strategic focus: Neuter short form with быть. The neuter short form сделано joins было to form a past passive: всё было сделано. It reports that everything had been done.
Strategic focus: Plural short form. The plural short form сделаны agrees with уроки and predicates the result with быть understood in the present. The homework is finished.
Strategic focus: Feminine instrumental long form. After доволен the noun работой stands in the instrumental, and сделанной takes the matching feminine instrumental ending to agree with it.

missions.phrase: Мы говорим о сделанном выборе спокойно.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine prepositional long form. The preposition о governs the prepositional case, so выборе and сделанном take prepositional endings and agree as the choice that was made.

missions.phrase: Я вижу аккуратно сделанную модель самолёта.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Feminine accusative long form. With the inanimate object модель the participle takes the accusative -ую, so сделанную matches it in gender, number and case as the model that was built.
